claims.meaning: The receipt proves successor Ratification from owner-effective merged decisions and authorizes the 21-path deletion only as a verified technical precondition; repository-owner merge of the finalization pull request is the effective supersession and deletion act.

verification.retrieval: Authenticated GitHub Git Data, Commits, and Pull Requests APIs at exact immutable commits; no authority evidence was constructed from the migration ledger.
verification.digestMethod: Git blob SHA-1 over exact bytes; SHA-256 over exact files, parsed principle blocks, status-normalized semantic blocks, catalogs, decision scopes, mappings, and this receipt body.
verification.offlineLimit: Offline validation proves committed structure, frozen mappings, local Studio semantics, deletion state, and receipt integrity. Authenticated live verification is required to re-read private remote authority bytes and owner merge metadata.
